name: Cadborosaurus
description: Cadborosaurus, popularly 'Caddy', is a sea-serpent cryptid reported along the Pacific coast from Alaska to California, with the densest cluster of sightings in the inland waters around Vancouver Island, British Columbia, and named after Cadboro Bay near Victoria.

aliases.name: Cadborosaurus willsi
aliases.meaning: Proposed (non-validated) species name applied by Bousfield and LeBlond (1995)

aliases.name: Sisiutl
aliases.meaning: Two-headed sea serpent of Pacific Northwest Coast tradition (a related but distinct figure)

origin: The reported range covers the Pacific coast from Alaska to northern California, with the densest cluster of sightings in the inland waters around Vancouver Island, the Strait of Georgia, Puget Sound, and adjacent inlets.
